native_result.query: What proportion of studies in Experimental Economics were conducted in a lab setting?
native_result.HypoA: In Experimental Economics, all studies (both original and replication) were conducted in a lab setting (100%), while in Psychology, a small proportion of replication studies were also conducted online (8.8%)
native_result.HypoB: In the Experimental Economics (project=='ee') slice of the supplied meta-regression dataset, 17 of 18 original studies (≈94.4%) were conducted in a lab setting under the conventional proxy (subjects.o == 'students' AND online.o == 0). The lone exception is ee.4 'Participation', which used a community subject sample.
native_result.WorkflowB: 1. Loaded the wide table (927×57) and aggregated table (143×15) from data/. 2. Subset project=='ee' (18 rows; id-unique within EE; no overlap with other projects). 3. Filtered the denominator: id-deduped, effect_size.o non-missing, drop==False. All 18 EE rows satisfy both filters, so N=18. 4. Defined proxy A = (subjects.o=='students') AND (online.o==0); counted numerator k=17. 5. Reported sensitivity proxies B (offline only: 18/18), C (us_lab.o==1: 11/18), D (A ∧ us_lab.o==1: 10/18), and the anti-lab counter-example E (subjects.o=='community': 1). 6. Cross-tabbed experiment_country.o × us_lab.o to show that the 7 us_lab.o==0 EE studies are all non-US university labs (DE×2, CH×2, UK×1, AU×1, AT×1) with subjects.o=students + online.o=0 + compensation.o=cash, justifying why proxy C under-counts. 7. Cross-checked with the aggregated table: 18 EE rows in both files; aggregated file has no lab-identifying fields and is therefore not used in the calculation. 8. Saved artifacts/analysis_main.py (executable script) and artifacts/ee_lab_breakdown.csv (per-EE-study breakdown with all proxy flags).

sub_hypo.context: Original and replication studies in the Experimental Economics replication project.

gold_sub_hypo.full_hypo: In Experimental Economics, all studies (both original and replication) were conducted in a lab setting (100%), while in Psychology, a small proportion of replication studies were also conducted online (8.8%)

sub_hypo.text: Of 18 original studies in Experimental Economics, 17 (approximately 94.4%) were conducted in a lab setting under the proxy of student subjects and offline conduct.
sub_hypo.context: Original studies in the supplied meta-regression wide table with project=='ee', deduplicated by id, with non-missing effect_size.o and drop==False; all 18 EE studies meet these criteria.
sub_hypo.relations: The conjunction subjects.o=='students' AND online.o==0 holds for 17 of 18 studies, yielding approximately 94.4% under the conventional lab-setting proxy.

sub_hypo.text: The lone exception to the conventional lab-setting proxy is ee.4, 'Participation', which used a community subject sample.
sub_hypo.context: The same 18 eligible Experimental Economics original studies (project=='ee') in the supplied meta-regression wide table.
sub_hypo.relations: The study with id=='ee.4' and title=='Participation' has subjects.o=='community', rather than 'students', and therefore fails the student-and-offline proxy despite being offline; it is the only exception.

The lone exception is ee.4 'Participation', which used a community subject sample.

Malformed judge output raises an evaluation error; no hidden retries.
evaluator_config.aggregation: recall_context * mean_accuracy_score; unmatched predicted contexts stay in denominator
evaluator_config.native_behavior_preserved: Variable/relation comparisons receive full hypotheses for each matched context pair.

details.score_scope: Reference agreement of submitted hypothesis; execution is not independently verified by this native metric.
